revise.title: Overview: what needs you today
revise.lead: The first screen after sign-in lists every request, payment and tour result waiting for the team, so nothing is missed, then shows how the whole business is doing.
callouts: Today's task tiles
Counts of gift requests to answer, payments awaited, gifts to prepare or hand over. Each tile opens the matching filtered list.
Tour work
Tours that ended and need a result, overdue balances, bookings delivered but unpaid, and late payments to check.
Money still to collect
Shows what accepted orders and tour bookings still owe, with the next pickups and departures beside it.

revise.title: Handle gift orders step by step
revise.lead: Every gift request starts unpaid. The team confirms it can prepare the gift, and only then is the guest asked to pay.
callouts: Tabs by order stage
Awaiting confirmation, awaiting payment, preparing, ready, balance owed, completed and cancelled, each with a live count.
Accept, change or decline
Accepting holds the stock and asks the guest to pay within 24 hours. Changes and declines need a note.
Complete only when paid
An order can be completed only after handover and full payment. Partner commission is then recorded once.

revise.title: Manage tour departures and guest lists
revise.lead: A departure is one dated run of a tour. The schedule shows how full each one is and who still owes money, then opens the guest list.
callouts: Seats and holds apart
Confirmed seats and temporary 15-minute holds are counted separately, so a seat is never sold twice.
Money to collect
Each departure shows the unpaid balance of its bookings, and flags overdue balances and late payments.
Result per booking
After the tour ends, mark each booking Service delivered or No-show. Nothing is completed automatically.

revise.title: Booking detail, payments and completion
revise.lead: One page holds everything about a tour booking: what the guest agreed to, money received and owed, and the next step for the team.
callouts: Terms as booked
Price, payment rule and cancellation policy are saved at booking, so later tour changes never alter this booking.
Overdue balances
Each departure's saved rule decides: cancel and release seats after the deadline, allow a grace period, or leave it to you.
Strict completion
Completion needs service delivered and full payment. A no-show never earns commission or a review.

new.title: Decide on a new gift request
new.lead: A request shows who asked, what they want, the pickup date and place, and the stock for each item. Nothing is paid until the shop accepts.
callouts: Stock checked per item
Each line shows how many are available against how many are needed. Stock is held only when you accept.
Clear confirmation
Accepting states the pickup date and place and the amount the guest must pay, with a 24-hour deadline.
Source and policy visible
The partner who brought the guest and the payment and cancellation terms from order time sit on the same page.

new.title: Change the date or place, or decline
new.lead: When the requested pickup does not work, the shop can agree a new date or place with the guest, or decline with a reason the guest receives.
callouts: Only valid dates offered
The calendar greys out past days and Sundays, when both pickup places are closed. A note to the guest is required.
Still a request
A changed order stays unconfirmed until the shop accepts it, so the guest never pays for a date nobody confirmed.
Decline with a reason
Pick a reason and add an optional message. The guest gets both by email, and other orders are unaffected.

new.title: Record cash and bank payments safely
new.lead: Guests may pay at the shop or by bank transfer. The team records that money here, and the order's balance updates at once.
callouts: Cash, bank transfer or other
Choose how it was paid and when it arrived. The button states the result: Record CHF 62.30 cash, balance CHF 0.00.
Duplicate warning
Recording the same amount again within 10 minutes shows a Possible duplicate warning before anything is saved.
No overpayment
An amount above what is still owed is blocked with a clear message, so balances stay correct.

new.title: Hand over, collect the balance, complete
new.lead: Marking a gift handed over does not close the order. Completion unlocks only when the guest has paid in full.
callouts: Five visible steps
A progress bar runs from Accepted through Preparing, Ready and Handed over to Completed, with the next step named.
Locked while money is owed
Complete stays locked with the reason, such as CHF 62.30 still owed on a 30% deposit order.
Commission recorded once
Completing logs who did it and when, records the partner commission once and invites the guest to review.
browsers: Paid in full, ready to complete

new.title: Seats sold versus seats on hold
new.lead: While a guest is paying, their seats are held for 15 minutes. The guest list shows confirmed bookings and held seats side by side.
callouts: Booked and holds counted apart
The schedule reads, for example, 3 of 12 booked, Holds 3, free 6. Held seats cannot be taken by others.
Pending guests are marked
A booking waiting for its first payment shows Seats held for payment until it is paid or the hold expires.
Late payments flagged
If money arrives after a hold expired, the booking stays expired and the departure shows To reconcile.

new.title: Record who came and who did not
new.lead: After a tour ends, the team marks each booking. A confirmation explains exactly what the choice does to money, commission and reviews.
callouts: Only after the tour ends
Buttons stay disabled, with the end time shown, until the tour is over. Nothing is completed automatically.
Service delivered
Confirms the guest took part. Money stays as it is, and completion still needs full payment.
No-show
Money paid and the balance stay as they are: no refund, no debt waived, no commission and no review.

new.title: Collect the balance and complete a booking
new.lead: A guest who took part but still owes money can pay the team directly. Once the balance is zero, the booking can be completed.
callouts: External payments only
The sheet records money already received outside the platform, up to the amount still owed, by cash, bank transfer or other.
Complete asks to confirm
The dialog says commission is recorded once and the guest can review the tour.
Full history kept
Booking history lists each step with who and when, and the commission line changes from estimated to recorded.

new.title: What happens when a balance is late
new.lead: Each departure saves its own rule for unpaid balances at booking time. The shop sees the result without chasing each case.
callouts: Cancel and release seats
Under this rule the booking is cancelled at the next check after the deadline, and the seats are free again.
Grace period
Another rule waits a set time, such as 48 hours, and shows the date until which the guest may still pay.
Paid money is kept
Cancellation keeps what was already paid on record. Refunds are not part of this version of the product.

new.title: No-shows and payments that arrive late
new.lead: Two awkward cases are handled explicitly: a guest who paid but never came, and money that reaches the shop after a hold expired.
callouts: No-show keeps the money
The booking shows No-show and Paid in full. Nothing is refunded automatically and no commission is earned.
Expired stays expired
Late money never revives a booking whose hold ran out. The seats were already released.
Flagged for the team
The booking shows a reconciliation warning, so staff check the payment and arrange a refund by hand.

new.title: Automatic emails keep staff informed
new.lead: The product emails the shop team when something needs attention. In this demo emails are not sent but listed in a mail panel by recipient.
callouts: Staff, guest and partner mail
The panel separates what the team, the guest and the partner each receive, in the recipient's language.
Example: auto-cancel
When a late balance cancels a booking, staff are told which guest, how many seats are free and what was paid.
Prototype only
No real email leaves the demo. The panel shows the planned content so the client can review every message.
